operating_entities.note: The page is a flat list of entity cards (type of enterprise, products and services, year founded/acquired, office, territory, regulator, website); it names iA Financial Corporation Inc. as the 'Holding corporation' but does not draw an ownership tree, so every other entity is recorded with parent = iA Financial Corporation Inc. and intermediate holdings (e.g., U.S. entities under Industrial Alliance Insurance and Financial Services Inc.) are not shown. Page intro: 'iA Financial Group is one of the largest insurance and wealth management groups in Canada.' iagam.ca footer confirms 'iAGAM' is a tradename of Industrial Alliance Investment Management Inc. and iA Global Asset Management Inc.

Tenure: iagam.ca bios give 'joined iA' years only for Adam (2021), Payeur (1999), Bellefleur (2024), Takk (2024-06), Portelance (2021); Rai has conflicting 2020/2021 dates; Bannon, Sirois, Leduc, Mc Mahon, Cornillaut, Jacob-Roy, Felx, Kuperman have none and no LinkedIn snippet surfaced. Seat-start dates are null for all reports except Siciliano (MarketScreener).
Group-of-companies page gives no ownership tree; intermediate parents (e.g., U.S. entities, iA Auto Finance) not shown, so parent is recorded as iA Financial Corporation Inc. for all.
Industry start years for Bergeron and all iAGAM heads are given only as 'N years of experience' (not dated), left null.
Web-search budget exhausted before name-specific LinkedIn-snippet searches for Sirois, Leduc, Cornillaut, Jacob-Roy, Felx, Kuperman, Mc Mahon.
